The file is vendored **unmodified**. Do not edit it in place: put wrappers
and fixes in `rtl/` next to it so the upstream hash above stays verifiable:

```sh
sha256sum rtl/third_party/shaman/tt_um_psychogenic_shaman.v
```

The Verilog is generated by Amaranth (the upstream `info.yaml` lists
`language: Amaranth`); the Amaranth source itself is not in the upstream repo.

## License note

The upstream repository's top-level `LICENSE` is Apache-2.0 (the Tiny Tapeout
template default), but the header of `tt_um_psychogenic_shaman.v` itself grants
GPL-3.0-or-later. The file-level grant is the one that applies to this file, so
`LICENSE` here is the GPL-3.0 text.

## Interface

Top module: `tt_um_psychogenic_shaman` (standard Tiny Tapeout pinout).
The core hashes pre-padded 512-bit blocks; padding is done by the host
(see `model/sha256_ref.py`).

| Pin          | Dir | Function |
|--------------|-----|----------|
| `ui_in[7:0]` | in  | data byte |
| `uo_out[7:0]`| out | digest byte |
| `uio[0]`     | out | result ready |
| `uio[1]`     | out | begin processing data block |
| `uio[2]`     | in  | parallel loading mode |
| `uio[3]`     | in  | result next (advance digest byte) |
| `uio[4]`     | out | busy |
| `uio[5]`     | out | processing received data block |
| `uio[6]`     | in  | start (reset digest) |
| `uio[7]`     | in  | clock in data byte |
